body: Built for visual workflows, ready for agents.
Your visual files organized in one place, ready to share as a gallery — not a zip folder. With our MCP server, your agents can now do more than just finding, tagging, and sharing for you.
Over two million creatives, and world-class brands
Images, videos, 3D models, GIFs, PDFs. Playbook instantly show previews and describes every file as it lands.
"Every image with our packaging on white." Playbook searches by visual content, not just what somebody named them.
Playbook speaks MCP, so the AI tools your team already uses can search, tag, and move assets without anyone leaving the chat. One URL to connect. Nothing to build.
1 Copy the Playbook connector URL You'll paste this into Claude in the next step. https://mcp.playbook.com
You'll paste this into Claude in the next step.
2 Add it in Claude → Connectors Open Settings → Connectors, add a custom connector, and paste the URL. Open Claude connectors
Open Settings → Connectors, add a custom connector, and paste the URL.
3 Sign in and start Authorize Playbook once, then ask Claude to find, tag, or organize anything in your library. Start asking
Authorize Playbook once, then ask Claude to find, tag, or organize anything in your library.
Post house just dropped the Scene 4 delivery into the workspace. Help me sort clips into Scenes selections, stills into Images, anything branded into Collateral.
Reading 16 new assets against the project boards...
Eight clips into Scene selections, three stills into Images, five into Collateral. The two re-renders of shots went in as versions. Nothing overwritten.
The controls your IT and brand leads ask for are all here. What is missing is the six-week rollout, the seat minimums, and the training deck nobody reads.
A UI only the librarian opens
Import direct from Dropbox, Drive, or your current DAM. And if you ever want out, every asset, tag, and version is yours to take. Most DAMs make leaving expensive. We made it a button.
